name: frameColor
meaning: RGB tint of the animated frame quad; initialised to 0x4BCCFF

name: baseColor
meaning: RGB tint of the static base quad; initialised to 0x4BCCFF

name: x
meaning: cursor X in virtual HUD units

name: y
meaning: cursor Y, stored already biased by half the first frame's height

name: frameW
meaning: on-screen width of the animated frame quad, taken from the last loaded frame bitmap

name: frameH
meaning: on-screen height of the animated frame quad

name: baseU
meaning: U origin of the base bitmap (resource 0x27) in its texture page

name: baseV
meaning: V origin of the base bitmap

name: baseWMinus1
meaning: base bitmap width - 1, used as both quad width and UV span

name: baseTexIndex
meaning: texture index of the base bitmap

name: frames
meaning: four animation frames from resources 0x28..0x2B, 8 bytes each: {u8 u; u8 v; u8 wMinus1; u8 hMinus1; u16 pad; u16 texIndex}

name: frameIndex
meaning: current animation frame 0..3, advanced every 100 ms by UiCursor_Animate

name: slideX
meaning: horizontal offset added to the base quad's X, computed as (t256 * frames[0].wMinus1) >> 8
